result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall. Layout, spacing, and typography look consistent. Only a couple of minor cosmetic observations were found; no critical or major visual defects detected.

issues.description: The notification bell icon has a red badge that slightly overlaps the icon's edge, which could look slightly cramped.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the 'See all' link alignment matches the section title baseline on all devices.

issues.description: The search bar placeholder text 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' is low-contrast light gray on light gray background.
issues.suggestion: Increase contrast (e.g., darker gray) to improve readability for all users.
